risks.risk: Exact HP model is not readable, so duplex speed, toner type, and parts availability/pricing are unknown.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label (usually on the side/back) showing the exact model number (e.g., Mxxx) and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic HP colour MFP with unknown duplex speed and unknown condition; treat as worst-case for performance/parts availability.

risks.risk: Duplex (two-sided) printing may not work or may require configuration/parts.
risks.proof: A short video or photo showing a duplex test print (single job printing both sides) with the printer’s duplex mode enabled.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not reliably doing two-sided printing (or as requiring service).

risks.risk: Scanner/fax/copier functions may be faulty even if printing works.
risks.proof: A photo/video showing a scan-to-email/scan-to-USB (or a copy made from the scanner bed) with a visible result.
risks.if_unproven: Price as print-only / limited functions until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Toner/consumables status is unknown (low toner, empty cartridges, drum issues).
risks.proof: Photos of the toner levels/status screen (or cartridge bay view) and a close-up of any error messages.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming cartridges/drums may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Overall condition (paper jams, rollers, fuser wear) is unknown.
risks.proof: A video of a full print cycle from tray to output (no jams) plus a close-up of the paper path area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing inspection/possible minor repairs.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact HP model number label (side/back) and serial.
Photo of the printer’s status screen showing toner levels and any active/error messages.
Video showing duplex printing (one job printing both sides) or a duplex test page.
Video/photo showing a scan or copy result from the scanner bed.
